objects.name: a folded stack of evening papers
a writing desk with a locked drawer

people.name: Sterling Lathrop
people.relationshipToVictim: a childhood friend of the victim from the same block

secret.description: Sterling Lathrop hands a parcel of stolen goods to a man at the Kitchen at 9:00 PM.

people.name: Assunta Ruggiero
people.role: a dentist with rooms on the third floor

secret.description: Assunta Ruggiero drinks alone in the Bar from 7:30 PM to 8:00 PM and will claim to have been anywhere else.

motive.description: wanted the victim out of a lease

secret.description: Klara Lindemann meets the victim alone in the Victim's Suite from 7:00 PM and asks for money.
Concetta Vitale is alone with Emilio Moretti in the Roof Garden from 8:30 PM to 9:00 PM, and kills Emilio Moretti at 9:00 PM.

coverSecret.description: Concetta Vitale is not the person the register says. Nothing is hidden about the evening; the lie is in the paperwork.

people.name: Karl Dettweiler
people.role: a travelling salesman in patent medicines

secret.description: Karl Dettweiler slips out to the Street from 8:30 PM to 9:00 PM to settle with a bookmaker.
Nora Rafferty goes through the papers in the Victim's Suite from 7:30 PM while the victim is downstairs.

method.name: a gunshot
method.bodyEvidence: One bullet below the sternum. Powder burns on the shirt front: fired close.

environment.radioContent: a talk on the tariff by a congressman
environment.radioOutcome: the congressman lost his place and had to start a page over

Emilio Moretti was found in the Roof Garden. The coroner puts death between 8:30 PM and 9:00 PM. One bullet below the sternum. Powder burns on the shirt front: fired close.
A nickel-plated revolver is missing from the Front Desk. The drawer it was kept in is open and the oiled cloth is still in it.
Rain began at 10:00 PM and did not let up. Anyone out on the street after that came back in wet.
Sterling Lathrop says Karl Dettweiler came in off the street at 11:00 PM with a soaked coat, so Karl Dettweiler was outside at 10:30 PM.

Otto Reinhardt says the bar radio carried a talk on the tariff by a congressman at 10:30 PM, and that the congressman lost his place and had to start a page over. Anyone in the bar could tell you that.
Concetta Vitale's papers do not hold up. Two signatures in the guest register, a month apart, are in different hands.
Found in the Front Desk: A lease assignment made out in Assunta Ruggiero's name, waiting only on Emilio Moretti's signature.
Sterling Lathrop says Emilio Moretti told Assunta Ruggiero the lease would go to somebody else at the quarter day.
Found in the Front Desk: A subpoena naming Emilio Moretti as a witness before the grand jury, with Concetta Vitale's name written in the margin.
Jacob Lefkowitz says Emilio Moretti said to Concetta Vitale that a man who testifies sleeps better.
